description.value: The study examined relationships between medial prefrontal glutamate and GABA+ concentrations and anterior cingulate BOLD activity during an implicit facial emotion-processing task in healthy volunteers.

description.value: Participants viewed facial expressions morphing from neutral to happy, sad, fearful, or angry expressions, with control trials involving evolving geometric shapes, and identified a color flash.

spans.text: The implicit EPR task ( ) consisted of a series of 1 s movies displaying facial expression that morphed in small increments from neutral to positive (happy) or negative (sad, fearful, or angry) expressions.

A first-level fixed-effect model was constructed in which each of the four emotion conditions (anger, fear, sad, and happy) were entered as separate conditions in a block design and contrasted with the shape condition, which served as the baseline in the design matrix.
